reviews.text: I was a client here for years before moving to the Bay Area recently. I contacted them to inquire about performing the same procedure they performed on one of my dogs two years ago since his issue had come back. I figured I still go to LA often and why not just go back here for the procedure. After explaining everything to two different people on two different days and after they both promised they would get back to me after speaking to the Vet there, I never heard a word from either again. After calling to check what was going on I basically was brushed off each time I called but told someone would get back to me. That never happened so I finally gave up. Way to treat a client!! (Unfortunately Dr. Grewal sold this practice and apparently took the amazing front office staff with him because the new people are horrible and rude. Especially Veronica. Which is rich considering the clients you treat like shit are the reason you all get a paycheck.) Don't waste your time, money, or energy going here. Much better options in the Los Angeles area.
Dr. Chen and her new staff are fantastic. She is very knowledgeable, patient, and very comforting to my dog. Bonus having a parking lot in back

This place sucks honestly. They insist my 1 year old otherwise completely healthy dog with a sore leg needs a urine sample before prescribing a short course of simple anti-inflammatory medication. You try getting a urine sample from a 1 year old dog. It’s a stupid and unnecessary request. And to withhold the medication for such a dumb reason causing more pain to the animal is just bad practice. Stay away from here if you care about your animal
Exceptional vet service and attention to detail.

**NEW OWNERSHIP--YAY!!!!!**

My Belgian Mallinois (2 of them) have been getting care here for three years. While we typically avoid this practice at all cost…. today we were pleasantly surprised to have an entirely different experience than what we are used to.

We came in today for an emergency visit and were THRILLED to meet the new owner of the practice.

Dr. Chen is compassionate, kind, gentle, and an incredible communicator. My Malinois typically does not like vet visits (who does)—he typically wears a soft muzzle because he has a history of nipping with his previous male vet. This visit, however, was VERY different. No nipping, the anxiety was way less—and no wonder… Dr. Chen is such a soothing presence. She handled Thor so gently, with so much care (😭😩❤️), and this was the first time I saw him have truly positive vet experience.

We can’t wait to come back for his annual exam and as a fur-mom I feel so much better knowing Dr.Chen is the new owner and so passionate about working with animals. We really connected and I cannot say enough what a positive change this is for the community. Thank you for coming to WeHo Dr. Chen! Thor was so happy to meet you! & We are so happy to have you 🤗

I don’t usually leave reviews, good or bad. I am a long time client of The Melrose Vet going back to when they first opened. I was sad to learn that the original owner sold the practice but my first visit with the new owner and vet was extremely positive. In some ways better than previous. Dr. Chen was very thorough, caring, and patient with a difficult cat. I thought she listened to all of my concerns and answered all my questions without me feeling like i was ever rushed. And I found the total bill to be reasonable. I know that the vet business is very difficult overall and I have had good and bad experience over the years with different vets but I feel like the new ownership here is quite solid.
Friendly staff, nice veterinarian and biggest plus of all....being allowed to go back with my dog to the examination room!

I bonded with a stray cat and when I was able to catch him he was brought  to Melrose vet. They were the only ones willing to help me full on. I had gone to so many different veterinarian friends recommended  or older vets that I used to go to, but nobody would help me. I started a google search and came across Melrose Vet. So kind and understanding from day one and suggested I make an appointment and cancel if I didn’t catch him the night before. My cat Romeo  aka Row Row loved the  staff and was very comfortable with them as they took their time  gaining  trust with him before trying to handle him. I highly recommend them as most reviews were praising exactly what I experienced. Some other Google reviews saying they were too expensive but honestly I did not find that,  a good vet is going to cost more.  I did not want to take a  scared cat to a facility  where he would be tossed around with other cats just to get a quick fix. Melrose Vet  even discussed insurance companies with me for future care. They are extremely compassionate with the animals and all  fur  babies are in a safe place with them. They will be my vet from now on and have already given their info to many people. I highly recommend this facility.!! And I highly recommend you get pet insurance. Lemonade, Costco,, many more you can choose from.

They saved my dogs life a long time ago. Since then their prices have 2x and 3x. I understand california ranks very low economically in general, but for $2000 the list of treatments and prescriptions are available in Arizona for $705. So the question becomes is it worth it for me to spend 16 hours roundtrip in the car with my dog, but save over $1120 after gas? Sadly the answer is yes. They are too damn expensive. Tricking patients into an injection prescription per dose is not clear either. I also tried getting a call through to collect the prescription information for my dog, but they didnt answer on more than a dozen attempts. There is no reason for them to charge so much above even the local market. They do great work, but i dont earn six figures and cant possibly afford this spot ever again

Fantastic experience at The Melrose Vet. The whole staff is friendly and we’re so kind to my reactive rescue Maggie. The vet techs did a great top taking blood and giving her vaccines. They were so great that they were able to take her muzzle off and leave without having her wear it. I found the vet and the whole team so friendly and professional, and would highly recommend them to anyone looking for a vet.
Had the best first vet experience with my new puppy. The staff was so warm and welcoming and the clinic had such a great ambiance and environment!
Very caring and compassionate veterinarian and staff. I felt supported. Will come back!
Super solid vet, professional staff and open on weekends.  5 out of 5 would recommend.

I have a dog with behavioral issues and can be aggressive to strangers… Especially vets and I have to praise David, who is such a wonderful team member at this facility and have made me feel so comfortable and welcome and have been so supportive of giving my dog the care he needs the way that he can best receive it. Thank you David. I also have had a wonderful experience with Irvin recently and I’m really happy that he is a team member at this facility as well.

My cat Nala recently was unable to urinate and was diagnosed with a UTI. This was his first time ever having this issue. At the first visit, he was given an injection and I was instructed to switch him to a prescription diet because his urinalysis showed crystals. That visit cost about $840.

I followed every instruction given. About a week later, the exact same emergency happened again, so we returned. This time I was told Nala was completely blocked by crystals. Dr. Choi told me they would need to unblock him and place a catheter for 3 days so he could urinate, and that although hospitalization is typical, he could instead be sent home with daily monitoring.

I was initially quoted about $661. After agreeing to proceed, I was suddenly told the real estimate was closer to $1,200. Despite this significant price change, I agreed immediately because I was told this was urgent and life-threatening. I signed the waiver and trusted their guidance. Then I was told there may be another additional injection charge.

About 2.5 hours later, Dr. Choi called and said he had unblocked Nala but did NOT place the catheter because he “didn’t feel it was necessary.” This was a complete departure from the treatment plan I was given. He also confirmed there was still a chance of re-blockage.

At that point, I trusted his decision and brought Nala home.

More than 24 hours later, Nala still had NOT urinated.

I immediately called the clinic and was told they had “exhausted their resources” and I needed to take him to an emergency hospital.

When I called back for clarification, I spoke with staff and then the manager, Kevin Jenkins. I was then told they DO NOT place catheters and send pets home at all because it is “too risky.” This directly contradicts everything Dr. Choi told me was going to happen. When I asked why I was given completely different information, I was told they “don’t know” why he said that.

There was no apology. No accountability. No ownership. Just a free recheck offered—but if my cat needed to be unblocked again, I would be charged again on top of everything already paid.

The level of miscommunication and contradiction here is unacceptable, especially in a life-threatening medical situation. I was given one treatment plan, it was changed without clear explanation, and then the clinic completely disowned what their own doctor told me.

In my opinion, this is gross negligence in communication and patient care. A critical procedure was explained, then not performed, and the owner was left confused, misled, and forced into emergency care elsewhere.

Now I am left taking my cat to an emergency vet, likely facing thousands of dollars in additional costs, because of their failure to communicate a consistent and accurate treatment plan.

Pet owners deserve honesty, consistency, and responsibility—especially in emergencies. Melrose Vet provided none of these.
Very bad service totally unacceptable and untrustworthy hospital don’t take your pets to this place it’s really bad really unprofessional people

This practice is trustworthy & kind.  The offices and waiting rooms are  spotless.
I feel like a family member every time we visit or talk to The melrose Vet on the phone.  They are efficient when it comes to paperwork and are flexible if necessary with your appointment times.  I’ve been a dog mom in Los Angeles for over 35 years and I can honestly say this group of doctors & technicians is about as close to perfect as you can get.  The only thing I would change is making the parking options more obvious,  other than that, A+  all around.
